summary.text: Joe Seiwert is a Republican member of the Kansas House of Representatives representing District 101 (Reno County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the House since 2009.
Joe Seiwert is listed as chair of the Statewide Broadband Expansion Planning Task Force.

paragraphs.text: Joe Seiwert is listed as a member of the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee, the Corrections and Juvenile Justice Committee and the Water Committee.
The Legislature lists Joe Seiwert's occupation as Agricultural Business Owner.
The page names Linda Seiwert as Joe Seiwert's spouse.
